subject: Post-demo: Skyport evaluation orchestration & environment decisioning
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@skyport.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-18T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo: Skyport evaluation orchestration & environment decisioning

Hi Emily — thanks again for the demo time today. Quick recap and a proposed next-step plan so we keep momentum: I pulled together the success criteria worksheet and our environment options (attached).

Summary from our call:
- Goal: validate Redwood for clinical-note summarization in Skyport's triage flow (latency under 350ms p50, token-cost target <$0.0008/token, model output F1 >= 0.86 on your sample set).
- Primary constraint: PHI-sensitive data — you prefer not to send raw PHI to hosted endpoints without an executed DPA; you asked about VPC/on-prem options.

Proposed trial plan (we think will fit your timeline for an end-of-quarter decision):
1) Short host-based trial to show end-to-end flow (2 weeks) — uses Redwood hosted with redaction proxy so your engineers can see latency/cost and retry semantics quickly.
2) Dedicated sandbox (reserved capacity, shared GPU pool) for load and stability tests (2–3 weeks) — minimal infra setup on our side, SLA-like throughput observations.
3) VPC/private pilot for PHI validation and audit logs (2–4 weeks) — requires network and KMS configuration; we'll coordinate with your infra team.

Action items I propose:
- Emily: confirm which of the three paths you want to prioritize (hosted -> dedicated -> VPC or skip hosted) and share the contact for infra ownership.
- Marissa: partner on scoping the dedicated sandbox (capacity target = 4 concurrent long-context workers).
- Karthik: prep a VPC plan and estimate for on-prem-like audit logs and KMS integration; include expected lead times.

Attachments: success criteria workbook + environment option primer.

Next steps: if you confirm prioritization, I’ll lock calendar for a kickoff and assign owners.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter | Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
attachments: skyport-eval-success-criteria.xlsx, redwood-trial-env-options.pdf

From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@skyport.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Skyport Technical Ops <ops@skyport.ai>
Date: 2026-08-18T17:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Skyport evaluation orchestration & environment decisioning

Ben — really helpful summary, thank you. A few clarifications from our side: 

- We want to see the hosted flow first (fastest unblock) but cannot send unredacted PHI until legal signs the DPA. Hosted trial with a redaction/proxy layer sounds acceptable for initial latency/cost checks if we send de-identified samples.
- Priority order: hosted (de-identified) -> dedicated sandbox -> VPC pilot.
- Infra lead: Claire Ramos (claire.ramos@skyport.ai) will own the VPC onboarding and keys. Ops team copied for scheduling.

Two asks: can you scope the dedicated sandbox for 4 workers with 8k context, and include an estimate for the cost delta vs hosted? Also want a short checklist of what we need to provide to enable the VPC (network ranges, KMS provider details).

We’re aiming for an internal decision by Sept 10; that gives us time to run the hosted smoke test and a focused dedicated validation.

—Emily
Emily Chen | Head of Product
Skyport Health

Cc: Emily Chen <emily.chen@skyport.ai>
Date: 2026-08-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Skyport evaluation orchestration & environment decisioning

Thanks Ben / Emily — looping in a few details from infra/prod enablement side. 

Ben — I’ll take point on the dedicated sandbox. Quick plan and items I’ll own: 
- Capacity: 4 concurrent long-context workers, 8k tokens. Estimated baseline throughput: ~55 reqs/min aggregated for peak testing.
- Deliverables: capacity checklist, temporary credentials for your bench tests, and a configured test workspace in the Console.
- Timeline: can spin a dedicated sandbox within 5 business days once Skyport signs the sandbox MSA (I’ll attach the MSA template in the next note).

Karthik — can you draft the VPC onboarding checklist please; Claire (ops@skyport.ai) will need the network CIDR ranges, firewall ingress rules, KMS provider endpoints, and an approximate lead time for HSM/KMS integration (we’ve seen 10–15 business days typical).

Also, Emily — for the hosted smoke test we can provide de-identified sample payloads and a short script to measure p50/p95 latency. If you share the sample set, I’ll run a baseline and add results to the workbook.

Marissa Cole | Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Emily Chen <emily.chen@skyport.ai>, Claire Ramos <claire.ramos@skyport.ai>
Date: 2026-08-20T09:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Skyport evaluation orchestration & environment decisioning

Claire / Emily — welcome. I’m attaching a short VPC onboarding checklist here (see Drive link above) but copying the key asks inline so you can review quickly: 

- Required from Skyport: network CIDR(s) for peering, list of IPs to allow for health checks, decision on KMS provider (AWS KMS or customer HSM), and an SRE contact for L3 troubleshooting.
- Redwood deliverables: deployment manifest for the pilot, KMS integration guide, audit-log retention options, and a proposed schedule (kickoff -> infra prep -> smoke tests -> validation) that totals ~3 weeks post-kickoff if paperwork is complete.

Estimated kicks:
- Hosted smoke test (de-identified): 48–72 hours to instrument and gather metrics after we receive sample set.
- Dedicated sandbox: 5 business days to provision after MSA; 2–3 weeks of testing recommended.
- VPC pilot: 10–15 business days to integrate KMS + network, then 1 week of validation.

I’ll open a shared Confluence page for the runbook and post the onboarding checklist to the Drive folder. Ben — please set the kickoff for next Tue if that works for Skyport.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer | Platform Solutions (Infra Enablement)
Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood-vpc-onboarding-checklist.pdf
